brief:
A senior Hamas delegation concluded its visit to Malaysia, Shehab Wire reported. The group held discussions on developments affecting the Palestinian issue during meetings in the country. No details of the specific talks or participants were made public.

The visit represents part of Hamas's broader diplomatic engagement outside the Middle East. Malaysia, a Muslim-majority nation with significant regional influence, has previously hosted Palestinian political figures and maintained channels of communication with various Palestinian factions. The timing of the delegation's visit comes as Palestinian leadership continues efforts to navigate current political and security conditions affecting the territories.
